memories.content: Bill believes the fence is shared property and the Osei family should pay half the repair cost. He is willing to negotiate but will consider small claims if no agreement is reached.

A shared fence between Bill's property and the Osei family's property was damaged by a storm. The fence needs repair. Both parties have discussed the issue but have not yet agreed on how to split the cost. They have two months to reach an agreement before the option of small claims court becomes more likely.
